answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, as each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The ridge cap is applied at intake and harbor makes public the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a dune tag. The fee repeats 28 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
